note: sa, IAST (Roman with diacritics), not Devanagari. *** DO NOT CLONE THIS REPO WHOLE *** the CC BY grant is scoped BY ITS OWN WORDING to dcs/data and its children; the SIBLING tree corpus/GRETIL/ is GRETIL-derived (its own readme says so) and GRETIL upstream is CC BY-NC-SA — the NC clause is NOT cured by sitting in this repo. FETCH (verified, and deliberately sparse so it EXCLUDES the encumbered tree): git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1 https://github.com/OliverHellwig/sanskrit.git ohs && cd ohs && git sparse-checkout set --cone dcs/data/conllu/files && git checkout . — the sparse-checkout is LOAD-BEARING, not a convenience. SIZE: 270 texts, 15,900 chapter files, 744,757 text lines. FORMAT: each verse line is a '# text =' comment with sent_counter = verse and sent_subcounter = line, so half-verse boundaries are EXPLICIT and machine-readable — which is exactly what the Irish cell lacks. YAMAKA: Kiratarjuniya sarga 15, the citrakavya sarga, present complete (18 chapters, ~1,040 verses). PRASA: Gitagovinda present, textbook antya-prasa at fixed line-final position. NOT present: Sisupalavadha (the canonical yamaka sarga 19), Naisadhiyacarita, Bhattikavya. CAVEAT: DCS does not record which printed edition each text was digitised from, so the modern-edition layer is unattributed and rests on the express CC BY grant rather than an evidenced pre-1931 edition.
